dct_description_sm:
Overview

This feature service presents the Comprehensive Development Permit Area for Peachland and supports viewing and use of development permit area boundaries in a GIS environment. It contains a single polygon layer representing the permit area designation and includes core geometry information for spatial analysis and map display.

Feature Layer

  • Comprehensive Development Permit Area — Polygon features identifying the comprehensive development permit area used for planning and development management in Peachland.

Geographic Coverage

The service covers the Peachland area within the Regional District of Central Okanagan in British Columbia.

Use Cases

  • Planning and land use review
  • Development permit area mapping
  • Municipal and regional GIS reference
  • Supporting development application and regulatory workflows

Source and Use Information

The data is owned by the Distrcit of Peachland, provided by the GIS Section of the Regional District of Central Okanagan and is distributed under the Regional District of Central Okanagan Open Data License, with associated disclaimer and terms of use.
